Method of Attack: Encrypts documents on QNAP NAS devices using AES-256 encryption with RSA public key encryption of the AES key
Kills processes like apache2, httpd, nginx, mysqld, mysqd, php-fpm to facilitate encryption
Avoids encrypting files on devices with certain CIS country locales (Belarus, Ukraine, Russia)
Uses weak credentials and exploits known vulnerabilities to gain access
Communicates with command and control server via SOCKS5 proxy to download ransom note and RSA public key
Creates ransom notes with Tor site link and bitcoin address
Encrypts Microsoft Office, OpenOffice, PDFs, text files, archives, databases, photos, music, video, and image files
Attack Vector: Exploitation of known vulnerabilities on QNAP NAS devices
